legislation.title: Responsible Cormorant Management and Control Act of 2026
legislation.short_title: Responsible Cormorant Management and Control Act of 2026
legislation.summary: Requires the U.S. Fish and Wildlife Service to develop regional management frameworks for double-crested cormorants, including take parameters and conservation safeguards, in coordination with Regional Flyway Councils.
legislation.status_label: Passed House under suspension of the rules by voice vote, as amended (Nov 17, 2026); received in Senate and referred to Environment and Public Works (Nov 18, 2026)

vote.question: [LITMUS TEST] H.R. 8195 (119th): "Responsible Cormorant Management and Control Act of 2026" — Should this measure pass as written? Cast your community vote (without middlemen) and compare community will with how representatives vote.
